title: SeaDex Scout
description: Upgrades SeaDex recommends for your anime library, findings to check by hand, how your library compares with SeaDex, and whether seadex-scout is healthy.

list.name: container
list.label: Container
list.description: The value of the container label your log collector puts on seadex-scout's lines.

list.name: optional
list.label: Optional upgrades
list.description: Hide leaves out upgrades where you already have a SeaDex alt. Show lists them too.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Healthy means checks run and nothing fails. Upstream outage means SeaDex, AniList or the anime ID map is down, so there is nothing for you to fix. Needs attention is an error you can fix, and Stalled means checks stopped, so open Scout health at the bottom.

targets.expr:
8 * (sum(absent_over_time({container="$container"} | json msg="msg" | msg=~`cycle complete|cycle degraded|tick complete|tick degraded|reconcile started` [3h])) or vector(0))
+ 4 * (sum(absent_over_time({container="$container"} |= `reconcile complete` | json msg="msg" | msg=`reconcile complete` [72h])) or vector(0))
+ 2 * ((sum(count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition" | level=`ERROR` | condition!~`seadex-unreachable|seadex-catalogue-fetch-failing|seadex-window-oversize|anilist-lookups-failing|mapping-refresh-rejected` [1h])) > bool 0) or vector(0))
+ 1 * ((sum(count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition" | level=`ERROR` | condition=~`seadex-unreachable|seadex-catalogue-fetch-failing|seadex-window-oversize|anilist-lookups-failing|mapping-refresh-rejected` [1h])) > bool 0) or vector(0))

panels.title: Upgrades available
panels.description: Upgrades SeaDex recommends for what you have, after your filters. Upgrades where you already have a SeaDex alt are hidden unless you pick Show under Optional upgrades at the top.

targets.expr: count(sum by (al_id, arr, season, recommended_group, seadex_tags, info_hash, title) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `better release available` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", recommended_group="recommended_group", seadex_tags="seadex_tags", info_hash="info_hash", title="title", current_tier="current_tier" | msg=`better release available` | current_tier != "$optional" [2h])))

panels.title: Check by hand
panels.description: Findings seadex-scout could not decide on its own. The Check by hand table lists them.

targets.expr: count(sum by (al_id, arr, season, title, current_group, recommended_group, msg, arr_url) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `manual review` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", title="title", current_group="current_group", recommended_group="recommended_group", arr_url="arr_url" | msg=~`series spans multiple release groups, manual review|release group unverifiable, manual review` [2h])))

panels.title: Anime at SeaDex best
panels.description: Share of your anime on SeaDex where every season or film you have is SeaDex's best release. It updates once a day.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best="items_all_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best [26h])) / (max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_with_entry="items_with_entry" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_with_entry [26h])) > 0) * 100

panels.title: Anime at SeaDex alt
panels.description: Share of your anime on SeaDex where you have SeaDex's best or an alt, with at least one alt. SeaDex's best is often a remux, so an anime you keep as encodes usually counts here. It updates once a day.

targets.expr: (max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best_or_alt="items_all_best_or_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best_or_alt [26h])) - max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best="items_all_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best [26h]))) / (max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_with_entry="items_with_entry" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_with_entry [26h])) > 0) * 100

panels.title: Upgrades available
panels.description: Upgrades SeaDex recommends for your library, newest first. Upgrades where you already have a SeaDex alt are hidden unless you pick Show under Optional upgrades at the top. The Nyaa, AnimeBytes and Other columns show only when some upgrade has a link there.

targets.expr: sum by (al_id, arr, season, recommended_group, seadex_tags, info_hash, title, current_group, why, nyaa_url, ab_url, public_url, arr_url) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `better release available` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", recommended_group="recommended_group", seadex_tags="seadex_tags", info_hash="info_hash", title="title", current_group="current_group", current_tier="current_tier", status="status", recommended_revision="recommended_revision", nyaa_url="nyaa_url", ab_url="ab_url", public_url="public_url", arr_url="arr_url" | msg=`better release available` | current_tier != "$optional" | label_format why=`{{ if eq .status "newer_revision" }}{{ .recommended_revision }} available{{ else if eq .current_tier "alt" }}SeaDex alt{{ else if eq .current_tier "unlisted" }}Neither best nor alt{{ else }}Better release{{ end }}` [2h]))

min by (al_id, arr, season, recommended_group, seadex_tags, info_hash, title) (min_over_time({container="$container"} |= `better release available` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", recommended_group="recommended_group", seadex_tags="seadex_tags", info_hash="info_hash", title="title", current_tier="current_tier" | msg=`better release available` | current_tier != "$optional" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000
and on (al_id, arr, season, recommended_group, seadex_tags, info_hash, title) sum by (al_id, arr, season, recommended_group, seadex_tags, info_hash, title) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `better release available` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", recommended_group="recommended_group", seadex_tags="seadex_tags", info_hash="info_hash", title="title", current_tier="current_tier" | msg=`better release available` | current_tier != "$optional" [2h]))

panels.title: Check by hand
panels.description: Findings seadex-scout could not decide on its own. Several groups on disk means your files mix release groups, and Group unknown means a release group is missing. Open the title and compare it with SeaDex yourself.

targets.expr: sum by (al_id, arr, season, title, current_group, recommended_group, msg, arr_url) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `manual review` | json msg="msg", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", season="season", title="title", current_group="current_group", recommended_group="recommended_group", arr_url="arr_url" | msg=~`series spans multiple release groups, manual review|release group unverifiable, manual review` [2h]))

panels.title: Anime in your library
panels.description: Your anime counted per series or film, from the daily check. Not at best or alt covers the rest on SeaDex, such as an older version, another group or no file yet. Hidden by your filters counts better releases seadex-scout does not report, mostly because your filters exclude them.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", anime_items="anime_items" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap anime_items [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_with_entry="items_with_entry" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_with_entry [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best="items_all_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best [26h]))

max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best_or_alt="items_all_best_or_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best_or_alt [26h])) - max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best="items_all_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best [26h]))

max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_with_entry="items_with_entry" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_with_entry [26h])) - max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best_or_alt="items_all_best_or_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best_or_alt [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", hidden_by_filters="hidden_by_filters" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap hidden_by_filters [26h]))

panels.title: SeaDex entries by what you have
panels.description: SeaDex entries in your library, grouped by what you have. SeaDex alt, Older version and Neither best nor alt are where upgrades come from.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_best="have_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_best [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_alt="have_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_alt [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_older_revision="have_older_revision" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_older_revision [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_unlisted="have_unlisted" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_unlisted [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", no_file="no_file" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap no_file [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", unverified="unverified" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap unverified [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", unattributed="unattributed" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap unattributed [26h]))
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", not_on_seadex="not_on_seadex" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap not_on_seadex [26h]))

panels.title: Anime at SeaDex best and alt, over time
panels.description: The two shares from the top row over time. It adds about one point a day, one for each daily check.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best="items_all_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best [$__interval])) / (max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_with_entry="items_with_entry" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_with_entry [$__interval])) > 0) * 100

(max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best_or_alt="items_all_best_or_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best_or_alt [$__interval])) - max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_all_best="items_all_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_all_best [$__interval]))) / (max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", items_with_entry="items_with_entry" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap items_with_entry [$__interval])) > 0) * 100

panels.title: Why
panels.description: What keeps Status from reading Healthy, over the last hour. A problem at SeaDex, AniList or the anime ID map needs nothing from you.

seadex-window-oversize.text: Too many SeaDex changes to fetch

targets.expr: sum by (condition, arr) (count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition", arr="arr" | level=`ERROR` | condition!=`` [1h]))
sum by (msg) (count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition", msg="msg" | level=`ERROR` | condition=`` [1h]))

panels.title: Last full check
panels.description: When the last full check finished. It runs once a day.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({container="$container"} |= `reconcile complete` | json msg="msg" | msg=`reconcile complete` | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap ts [72h])) * 1000

panels.title: Last check
panels.description: When the last check of any kind finished. It runs every 15 minutes by default.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({container="$container"} | json msg="msg" | msg=~`cycle complete|cycle degraded|tick complete|tick degraded` | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap ts [3h])) * 1000

panels.title: New feed releases in this range
panels.description: Releases the Torznab feed newly offered Sonarr and Radarr in this time range. It reads 0 when the feed is not set up.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer feed snapshot written` | json msg="msg", journal_new="journal_new" | msg=`indexer feed snapshot written` | unwrap journal_new [$__range]))

panels.title: Feed polls per tracker
panels.description: How often Sonarr and Radarr read the Torznab feed, per tracker. A tracker whose bars stop was turned off or marked failing in Sonarr or Radarr.

targets.expr: sum by (scope) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer request` | json msg="msg", scope="scope", feed="feed" | msg=`indexer request` | feed=`true` [$__interval]))
